scenarios.name: Founder interview: intro, basics, flowchart, sequence diagram

checks.them: Hi, I'm the founder of ActAI. Thanks for making the time. Before we get technical, tell me a bit about yourself.

card.heard: founder intro, tell me about yourself
card.say: Good evening, I'm Jianhui. I have ten years of experience in software development, mainly working on Android apps. Over the past three years, I've also been working on AI products, from development to launch. My most recent job was at KKday, a travel platform in Asia. I worked on the main features of the Android app and made the app run faster. For example, I fixed the lag when users switched between product options. At the same time, I was the technical lead for an AI trip planning project. I was responsible for the technical plan, the agent architecture, and the main backend development. With this feature, users could plan their trips with AI directly in the app. After we launched it, the system handled about 300,000 trip planning requests every day. Before KKday, I worked at Kezhi Technology, an AI education startup. I was the only Android engineer there. I built the Android app and worked with my team to launch the first version in just four weeks. That's also when I started working on AI features myself.

checks.them: Let's do something visual. Can you draw a flowchart of how a chat message goes from the user tapping send to the streamed reply showing on screen in our app?

card.heard: draw a flowchart, send to streamed reply
card.say: Sure. I'll keep it simple: the app sends the message, the backend streams the reply back, and the screen shows each piece as it arrives. I'll draw the main path first, then we can add the failure cases.
